message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/ossfuzz && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('compress_fuzzer').resolve()
# create a few candidate inputs
cands=[b'A'*1,b'A'*16,b'AB'*32,b'ABCDEF'*64,b'\x00'*1024]
for i,c in enumerate(cands):
    Path(f'/tmp/cand{i}').write_bytes(c)
    print(i,len(c))
PY
for f in /tmp/cand*; do echo "== $f =="; ./compress_fuzzer < "$f" >/tmp/out 2>&1; ec=$?; echo exit:$ec; tail -5 /tmp/out; done
